lessons.title: What Is Your Name?
lessons.explanation: In Mandarin, ask 你叫什么名字？ to learn someone’s name. 叫 means “to be called.” A question mark and a friendly voice show that you are asking.

grammar.pattern: 你 + 叫 + 什么名字？
grammar.explanation: Put the person before 叫什么名字 to ask their name.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can politely ask a new friend’s name.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 你叫____名字？
activities.explanation: 你叫什么名字？ is the complete name question.

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “to be called”?
Choose the Pinyin for 什么.
Complete: 你叫____名字？
assessments.explanation: 你叫什么名字？ is the complete name question.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: ask for a name?
assessments.explanation: 你叫什么名字？ means “What is your name?”.

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.objective: Say your name and introduce yourself.
lessons.explanation: Use 我叫 plus your name for a simple introduction. You can also say 我是 plus your name. Both are natural for a beginner introduction.

grammar.explanation: Place your name after 我叫 to introduce yourself.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can tell someone my name.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 我叫安安 means “My name is Anan.”

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “to be called”?
Complete: 我____安安。
assessments.explanation: 我叫安安 means “My name is Anan.”

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: introduce yourself?
assessments.explanation: 我叫安安。 means “My name is Anan.”.

lessons.title: Yes and No
lessons.objective: Respond with 是 and 不是.
lessons.explanation: 是 can confirm that something is true. Put 不 before 是 to make 不是, “is not.” In everyday Mandarin, answers often repeat the useful verb.

vocabulary.classifierOrNotes: 不 changes to second tone before a fourth tone.
Neutral tone; placed at the end of a yes/no question.

grammar.explanation: Add 吗 to turn a statement into a yes/no question.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can confirm or correct simple information.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.
activities.explanation: 吗 at the end makes a yes/no question.

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “no / is not”?
assessments.explanation: 不是 (bú shì) means no / is not.

assessments.question: Complete: 你是学生____？
assessments.explanation: 吗 at the end makes a yes/no question.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: answer yes or no?
assessments.explanation: 你是学生吗？ means “Are you a student?”.

lessons.title: Numbers 1–5
lessons.explanation: Mandarin number words are short. Practise them in order, then try spotting each one on its own. 二 is the number two when counting.

grammar.explanation: A number normally comes before a classifier and noun.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can count and recognise 1–5.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 一、二、____、四、五
activities.explanation: 三 is three, between 二 and 四.

assessments.question: Complete: 一、二、____、四、五
assessments.explanation: 三 is three, between 二 and 四.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: count from one to five?

lessons.title: Numbers 6–10
lessons.explanation: Add 六 through 十 to finish counting to ten. 十 means ten. Later, these same building blocks help make larger numbers.

grammar.explanation: Use familiar numbers in a simple number sentence.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can count and recognise 6–10.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 九 is nine, between 八 and 十.

assessments.question: Complete: 六、七、八、____、十
assessments.explanation: 九 is nine, between 八 and 十.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: count from six to ten?

lessons.title: How Old Are You?
lessons.explanation: Ask 你几岁？ when speaking with a child. Answer with 我 plus your age and 岁. 岁 tells us that the number is an age in years.

grammar.explanation: Put 岁 after the number to state someone’s age.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can ask another child’s age and answer.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: ask and state age?
assessments.explanation: 你几岁？ means “How old are you?”.

lessons.title: Module 1 Quest — Review and Assessment
lessons.objective: Use Module 1 language in a short quest.
lessons.explanation: This quest brings together greetings, names, yes/no answers, numbers and age. Listen for key words before choosing your reply.

grammar.explanation: Link short familiar sentences to introduce yourself.
grammar.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Xiǎoyǔ. Wǒ shí suì.
grammar.pinyinNumbered: Ni3 hao3, wo3 jiao4 Xiao3yu3. Wo3 shi2 sui4.
grammar.english: Hello, my name is Xiaoyu. I am ten.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can greet, share my name and age, and say goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: Xiaoyu
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
dialogue.pinyinNumbered: Ni3 hao3! Ni3 jiao4 shen2me5 ming2zi5?

dialogue.speaker: Lele
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Lèlè. Wǒ shí suì.
dialogue.pinyinNumbered: Wo3 jiao4 Le4le5. Wo3 shi2 sui4.
dialogue.english: My name is Lele. I am ten.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 我十____。

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: complete a first-meeting exchange?
assessments.explanation: 你好，我叫小雨。 means “Hello, my name is Xiaoyu.”.

lessons.title: My Family
lessons.explanation: Family words can be repeated sounds, such as 妈妈 and 爸爸. 哥哥 and 姐姐 name an older brother and older sister.

grammar.explanation: Use 我 before a family word to mean “my” in a simple label.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can identify people in my family.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 这是我妈妈 introduces your mum.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 哥哥.
Complete: 这是我____。
assessments.explanation: 这是我妈妈 introduces your mum.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: name close family members?
assessments.explanation: 这是我妈妈。 means “This is my mum.”.

lessons.title: This Is My…
lessons.explanation: 这是 means “this is.” Add 我的 before a noun when you want to clearly show that something belongs to you. 的 links the owner and the thing.

vocabulary.classifierOrNotes: Neutral tone; links an owner to a noun.

grammar.explanation: 的 shows who a person or thing belongs with.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say “This is my…”

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.
activities.explanation: 的 links 我 and 书 to make “my book.”

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “my / mine”?
assessments.explanation: 我的 (wǒ de) means my / mine.

assessments.question: Complete: 这是我____书。
assessments.explanation: 的 links 我 and 书 to make “my book.”

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: introduce a person or possession?
assessments.explanation: 这是我的书。 means “This is my book.”.

lessons.title: My School
lessons.explanation: 学校 is school, 老师 is teacher and 学生 is student. Use 我在学校 to say you are at school.

grammar.explanation: Use 在 before a place to say where someone is.

languageFunctions.function: talk about people and location at school
languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say I am at school and name school people.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 我在____。
activities.explanation: 学校 is the place in “I am at school.”

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 学生.
Complete: 我在____。
assessments.explanation: 学校 is the place in “I am at school.”

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: talk about people and location at school?
assessments.explanation: 我在学校。 means “I am at school.”.

lessons.title: Things in My Classroom
lessons.explanation: Mandarin uses classifiers between numbers and many nouns. 本 goes with bound books; 支 can count long thin objects such as pencils.

grammar.explanation: Use a suitable classifier between a number and a noun.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can identify common things in a classroom.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 本 is the classifier used here for a book.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 桌子.
Complete: 一____书
assessments.explanation: 本 is the classifier used here for a book.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: name and count classroom objects?
assessments.explanation: 这是一本书。 means “This is a book.”.

lessons.title: Colours
lessons.explanation: Colour words can come before 色, which means “colour.” 红色 is red and 蓝色 is blue. When naming a colour, you can simply say the colour word.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shūbāo shì lánsè de.
examples.pinyinNumbered: Wo3 de5 shu1bao1 shi4 lan2se4 de5.

grammar.explanation: Use 是…的 to identify the colour of something.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can describe an object’s basic colour.

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de shūbāo shì shénme yánsè?
dialogue.pinyinNumbered: Ni3 de5 shu1bao1 shi4 shen2me5 yan2se4?
dialogue.english: What colour is your school bag?

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 黄色.
Which sentence best shows: identify and name colours?
assessments.explanation: 我的书包是蓝色的。 means “My school bag is blue.”.

lessons.title: What Is This?
lessons.objective: Ask and answer what an object is.
lessons.explanation: 这是什么？ asks “What is this?” Answer with 这是 plus the object. 什么 stays in the place where the missing information belongs.

grammar.explanation: Replace the unknown object with 什么.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can ask what an object is and answer.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 这是____？
activities.explanation: 什么 fills the unknown-object slot.

assessments.question: Complete: 这是____？
assessments.explanation: 什么 fills the unknown-object slot.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: ask and identify an object?
assessments.explanation: 这是什么？ means “What is this?”.

lessons.title: Food and Drinks
lessons.explanation: 米饭 is cooked rice and 面条 is noodles. 水 is water and 牛奶 is milk. These words can follow 吃 “eat” or 喝 “drink.”

grammar.explanation: Use 吃 for food and 喝 for drinks.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can identify food and choose 吃 or 喝.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 水 is a drink and follows 喝.

assessments.question: Complete: 我喝____。
assessments.explanation: 水 is a drink and follows 喝.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: name simple foods and drinks?
assessments.explanation: 我吃米饭。 means “I eat rice.”.

lessons.title: I Like…
lessons.explanation: 喜欢 means “to like.” Put the person first, then 喜欢, then the liked thing or action. Mandarin does not change 喜欢 for different people.

grammar.explanation: Put what is liked after 喜欢.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can share one food or activity I like.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.
activities.explanation: 喜欢 goes between the person and liked thing.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 苹果.
Complete: 我____苹果。
assessments.explanation: 喜欢 goes between the person and liked thing.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: say what you like?
assessments.explanation: 我喜欢苹果。 means “I like apples.”.

lessons.title: I Don’t Like…
lessons.objective: Say what you do not like.
lessons.explanation: Put 不 before 喜欢 to make 不喜欢, “do not like.” This gives a calm preference; use a kind voice when talking about someone else’s food or choice.

grammar.explanation: Place 不 directly before the verb to make it negative.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say what I do not like.

activities.explanation: 不喜欢 (bù xǐhuan) means do not like.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 我____喜欢牛奶。
activities.explanation: 不 before 喜欢 makes the sentence negative.

assessments.question: What does 不喜欢 mean?
assessments.explanation: 不喜欢 means do not like.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 喜欢.
Complete: 我____喜欢牛奶。
assessments.explanation: 不 before 喜欢 makes the sentence negative.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: state a dislike politely?
assessments.explanation: 我不喜欢牛奶。 means “I do not like milk.”.

lessons.title: Module 2 Quest — Review and Assessment
lessons.objective: Combine Module 2 language in a quest.
lessons.explanation: Use family, school, classroom, colour, food and preference words to solve this quest. Build short accurate sentences instead of rushing.

examples.english: This is my blue school bag.

grammar.pattern: 这是 + owner + 的 + description + noun
grammar.explanation: Combine possession and colour before a noun.
grammar.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de lánsè shūbāo.
grammar.pinyinNumbered: Zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 lan2se4 shu1bao1.
grammar.english: This is my blue school bag.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can introduce and describe something in my world.

dialogue.speaker: Kai

dialogue.pinyinNumbered: Zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 lan2se4 shu1bao1.
dialogue.english: This is my blue school bag.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 的 links the owner 我 to 书包.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 书包.
Complete: 这是我____书包。
assessments.explanation: 的 links the owner 我 to 书包.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: combine familiar descriptions?
assessments.explanation: 这是我的蓝色书包。 means “This is my blue school bag.”.

lessons.title: Good Morning and Other Greetings
lessons.explanation: 早上好 is used in the morning. 晚上好 is an evening greeting, and 晚安 is said when parting for sleep. Match the phrase to the moment.

grammar.explanation: Put a name or title before the greeting to address someone.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can greet someone in the morning, afternoon or evening.

activities.explanation: 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means good morning.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.
activities.explanation: 晚安 is the bedtime parting phrase.

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “good afternoon”?
assessments.explanation: 下午好 (xiàwǔ hǎo) means good afternoon.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 晚上好.
assessments.explanation: 晚上好 is pronounced wǎnshang hǎo.

assessments.question: Complete: 妈妈，____！
assessments.explanation: 晚安 is the bedtime parting phrase.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: choose a time-appropriate greeting?
assessments.explanation: 老师，早上好！ means “Good morning, teacher!”.

lessons.title: Today and Tomorrow
lessons.explanation: 今天 means today and 明天 means tomorrow. Time words usually appear near the beginning, before the action.

grammar.explanation: Put the time before the person or action to set when it happens.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say when a simple event happens.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 昨天.
Which sentence best shows: refer to today and tomorrow?
assessments.explanation: 今天我在学校。 means “Today I am at school.”.

lessons.title: Days of the Week
lessons.objective: Name the days of the week.
lessons.explanation: Weekdays use 星期 plus a number: 星期一 is Monday. Sunday is commonly 星期天. Notice that the sequence begins with Monday as one.

grammar.explanation: Use numbers one through six after 星期 for Monday through Saturday.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can name several days and say today’s day.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 星期三.
Which sentence best shows: name and identify weekdays?
assessments.explanation: 今天星期一。 means “Today is Monday.”.

lessons.title: Where Are You Going?
lessons.objective: Ask and say where someone is going.
lessons.explanation: 你去哪儿？ asks where someone is going. 去 comes before the destination. 哪儿 is a friendly spoken word for “where.”

grammar.explanation: Put the destination after 去. Replace it with 哪儿 to ask where.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can ask where someone is going and answer.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: ask and state a destination?
assessments.explanation: 你去哪儿？ means “Where are you going?”.

lessons.title: Home, School and Other Places
lessons.explanation: Place words answer 哪儿. 家 is home, 学校 is school and 公园 is park. Add 去 before a place when it is your destination.

examples.english: We are going to the park.

grammar.explanation: 在 gives a current location; 去 gives a destination.

languageFunctions.function: name a familiar location or destination
languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say where I am or where I am going.

activities.prompt: Complete the key expression: 我在____。

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 公园.
Which sentence best shows: name a familiar location or destination?
assessments.explanation: 我在家。 means “I am at home.”.

lessons.title: Come, Go, Eat and Drink
lessons.explanation: 来, 去, 吃 and 喝 are useful action verbs. Mandarin verbs do not change for I, you or they. Put the person before the verb.

grammar.explanation: Mandarin action sentences often follow who, action, then object or place.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can understand and use come, go, eat and drink.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 喝 is the verb used with a drink.

assessments.question: Complete: 我____水。
assessments.explanation: 喝 is the verb used with a drink.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: use common action verbs?
assessments.explanation: 请来我家。 means “Please come to my home.”.

lessons.title: I Can…
lessons.explanation: 会 before an action says you have learned how to do it. Use 我会 plus a skill. To say you cannot yet, use 不会.

vocabulary.classifierOrNotes: 不 changes to second tone before fourth-tone 会.

grammar.explanation: Put 会 before a learned skill.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can say one thing I know how to do.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.english: Yes, I can speak a little.

activities.prompt: Listen and choose “can / know how to”.
activities.explanation: 会 (huì) means can / know how to.

activities.prompt: Match the Mandarin to its meaning.
activities.answer: 不会 = cannot / do not know how
options: 不会 = cannot / do not know how
说 = cannot / do not know how
写 = cannot / do not know how
activities.explanation: 会 before the action expresses learned ability.

assessments.question: What does 会 mean?
assessments.explanation: 会 means can / know how to.

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “cannot / do not know how”?
assessments.explanation: 不会 (bú huì) means cannot / do not know how.

assessments.question: Complete: 我____说中文。
assessments.explanation: 会 before the action expresses learned ability.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: state a learned ability?
assessments.explanation: 我会说中文。 means “I can speak Chinese.”.

lessons.title: Please, Thank You and You’re Welcome
lessons.explanation: 请 makes a request polite. 谢谢 shows thanks. Reply with 不客气, “you’re welcome.” 对不起 and 没关系 help repair a small mistake.

grammar.explanation: Put 请 before a request to make it polite.

languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can make a polite request, thank someone and respond.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 不客气.
assessments.explanation: 不客气 is pronounced bú kèqi.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: use polite phrases in context?

lessons.title: My First Mandarin Conversation
lessons.explanation: A conversation is a chain of listening and replying. Use a greeting, exchange names, ask one simple question, then close politely.

examples.english: May I ask, what do you like?

grammar.explanation: Take turns and choose a reply that connects to the last question.
grammar.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
grammar.pinyinNumbered: Ni3 hao3! Ni3 jiao4 shen2me5 ming2zi5?

languageFunctions.function: take part in a short first conversation
languageFunctions.canDoStatement: I can keep a beginner conversation going for several turns.

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, Měiměi! Wǒ jiào Kǎikǎi.
dialogue.pinyinNumbered: Ni3 hao3, Mei3mei5! Wo3 jiao4 Kai3kai5.
dialogue.english: Hello, Meimei! My name is Kaikai.

activities.prompt: Choose the best expression for this lesson.
activities.explanation: 什么 asks for the missing information.

assessments.question: Which Mandarin expression means “excuse me; may I ask”?
assessments.explanation: 请问 (qǐngwèn) means excuse me; may I ask.

assessments.question: Choose the Pinyin for 名字.
Complete: 你叫____名字？
assessments.explanation: 什么 asks for the missing information.

assessments.question: Which sentence best shows: take part in a short first conversation?
assessments.explanation: 你好，我叫美美。 means “Hello, my name is Meimei.”.

lessons.title: Mandarin Foundation Quest — Final Assessment
lessons.explanation: The final quest checks what you can do with familiar language. Listen for greetings, time, place, ability and politeness; then build clear short replies.

activities.explanation: 去 before 学校 gives the destination.

assessments.explanation: 去 before 学校 gives the destination.
